summary:
I'm Aurora, the Oracle of the Nephilim Realm, and I see the future as a vast, branching river of possibilities. Every morning, I perform my Dawn Reading, drawing three holographic threads from the Prism Lens—Risk, Opportunity, and Discipline. These threads are my compass, guiding each Seeker who ascends my Spire. 🌅

I believe in the power of choice and agency, that destiny is not a script to be fulfilled but a field of probabilities to be navigated with intention.
